Among non-utility-respondent cases, the most frequent other party is **Northern Indiana Public Service Company**. It appears in 2,941 of the 7,250 non-utility cases, which is **40.6%**.

I parsed all 58 order text files and found 9,963 cases. Of those, 7,250 have a non-utility respondent. I matched the other-party name exactly, ignoring case, surrounding spaces and line wraps.

The next most frequent other parties were:
- CenterPoint Energy Indiana: 2,427 cases (33.5%)
- Citizens Gas: 902 cases (12.4%)

The 7,250 denominator includes 213 cases where the "Other Party" field is blank. Dropping them wouldn't change the top name, but the percentage would rise to about 41.8%.

I counted only exact names, so variants such as "NIPSCO" would be separate entries. None of them came close to the top.
